visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A grand stage with a pipe organ background during the 'ANNUAL AWARDS CEREMONY'. Three men in black tuxedos and bowties stand on a red carpet. The middle man holds a white certificate while the others applaud. Yellow text '-2025 now-' is at the top. (2) Cut to an ambulance interior where a man lies on a stretcher with a yellow neck brace. Medical staff in blue gloves adjust equipment. Overlay reads '-2024 mo-'. (3) Back to 2025 in a luxurious hall with a highly ornate blue and gold painted ceiling. A man in glasses and a tuxedo looks up in awe. (4) Close-up at a dentist's office. A man's mouth is open with dental tools inside; he looks in pain. Overlay '-2024 mo-'. (5) Returning to the grand hall, the man in a tuxedo smiles and holds a white bottle of 'STEP V Omega-3' supplements to the camera. (6) CCTV footage of a gym where a person falls backward off a weight bench. Overlay '-2024 mo-'. (7) The man in a tuxedo walks onto the award stage, shakes hands with officials, and receives his award. A blue and orange subtitle banner appears at the bottom. (8) Outdoor cafe in Prague with the Astronomical Clock tower in the background. The man, now in a white shirt, speaks directly to the camera. (9) A group photo of 'TEAM PEETA FITNESS' is displayed, featuring several muscular men and women in branded gym attire. (10) Interior of a small, cluttered warehouse-like room where three men sit around a white table eating. (11) The man stands in front of a 'Peeta Take Take' sign holding a massive bowl of meat and vegetables. (12) He continues his narration, alternating between the grand indoor hall and the outdoor cafe setting, concluding with the 'STEP V' logo appearing on screen.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main character (Peeta Gege), 2 awards presenters, roughly 7 team members in photo, and several guests in the background of the hall.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A muscular Asian man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black tuxedo with a bowtie in formal scenes and a casual white button-down shirt in outdoor scenes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a grand historic hall (Municipal House, Prague) with gold moldings and pipe organs, a European street with an old clock tower, a modern gym interior, a cluttered warehouse space, and a dentist's office.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio begins with energetic orchestral BGM and sounds of applause. A male narrator starts speaking in a clear, narrative Mandarin tone, reflecting on his life before age 28. (2) As he mentions the hardships of 2024, the BGM shifts to a slightly more sentimental piano melody. Occasional 'whoosh' sound effects accompany visual transitions. (3) The speaker details his journey from starting a fitness studio to living in a warehouse. The acoustic texture remains clean, focused on the primary vocal signal. (4) Towards the end, as he talks about his success and current award, the BGM swells in volume and returns to an inspiring, high-tempo electronic-orchestral hybrid. Final sounds include a logo stinger/ding.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Past Struggles -> Growth -> Current Success/Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a brand storytelling piece for Peeta Gege, contrasting his recent international award in Prague with the physical and legal setbacks he faced in 2024. It aims to build emotional resonance and credibility before promoting his supplement brand, STEP V.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product bottle and company logo alongside a success story.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality production values with a strong focus on narrative contrast. The use of location-specific landmarks (Prague) adds a sense of global achievement.
